title: For Good Protein Millet Bars - Assorted

details.description:
Nutraj For Good Protein Millet Bars bring you a wholesome mix of nutrition and taste in every bite. Packed with protein-rich ingredients like millet, nuts, and seeds, these bars support energy, fitness, and healthy snacking. Available in assorted flavours, they are perfect for on-the-go lifestyles, gym sessions, or a quick wholesome snack anytime, anywhere.
Seeds & Berry Oaty Bar, Berry Nutty Almond Bar, Tangy Almond Nut Bar, Millet & Seed Bar
details.ingredients:
Seeds & Berry Oaty Bar Ingredients: Seeds (21%) [Sunflower Seeds (10%), Pumpkin Seeds (6%), Chia Seeds, Sesame Seeds], Fructooligosaccharide, Humectant (INS 965 (I)), Soy Granules, Oats, Honey, Jowar Crisps, Almonds (4%), Black Currant (4%), Rice Crispies, Cranberry (2%), Refined Sunflower Oil, Thickener (INS 412), Cinnamon Powder, Nature Identical Flavoring Substances, Emulsifier (INS 322 (I)), Salt, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Rosemary Extract.
Berry Nutty Almond Bar Ingredients: Nuts (50%) [Almonds (40%), Peanuts], Dark Compound Chocolate (15%) [Sugar, Edible Vegetable Fat, Cocoa Solids & Emulsifiers (INS 492, INS 322 (I)), Natural Flavouring Substances (Vanilla)], Liquid Glucose, Cranberries (7%) [Cranberries, Sugar, Refined Sunflower Oil], Fructooligosaccharide, Rice Crispies, Refined Sunflower Oil, Honey (2%), Sea Salt, Cocoa Powder, Emulsifier (INS 322 (I)), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Rosemary Extract.
Tangy Almond Nut Bar Ingredients: Nuts (46%) [Almonds (37%), Peanuts], White Compound Chocolate (15%) [Sugar, Hydrogenated Palm Kernel Fat, Milk Solids, Emulsifiers (INS 322 (I)), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances (Vanilla)], Liquid Glucose, Fructooligosaccharides, Soy Granules, Orange Pieces (5%), Rice Crispies, Refined Sunflower Oil, Honey (2%), Sea Salt, Emulsifier (INS 322 (I)), Nature Identical Flavour, Rosemary Extract.
Millet & Seed Bar Ingredients: Millet (23.5%) [Jowar Crispies, Jowar Flour], Oats (23%) [Rolled Oats, Oat Flour], Liquid Glucose, Fructooligosaccharide, Jaggery Powder (8%), Dehydrated Fruit (Tutti Frutti), Refined Vegetable Oil (Sunflower), Humectant (INS 422), Dehydrated Fruit (3%) [Cranberry], Sunflower Seeds (2%), Natural Identical Flavouring Substances.
